opening.argument: The speaker presents BitClub Network as an easy-income opportunity built around recruitment and recurring Bitcoin payments. He says, “if you bring and introduce other people to big-club network every time they get paid Bitcoin you get paid Bitcoin,” directly tying the promoter’s earnings to other people’s participation and payments. The structure is reinforced by the promise that viewers can “get paid every day for 1000 days for every unit,” while the description invites them to earn “DAILY, even with little to NO LIST!” These claims portray daily income as available even with little or no recruiting list, while also describing payment from a larger group of miners.
